content.user_title: Build an Interactive Portfolio That Converts
content.value_statement: Many portfolios fail to show value quickly. This skill helps organize project stories, role-specific proof, and contact paths for better portfolio outcomes.
actual_capabilities: Maps portfolio architecture around identity, best work, and contact paths.
Defines single-page, multi-page, and hybrid navigation options.
Structures project cards and case studies for quick scanning.
Frames project impact with results, role, process, and decisions.
Tailors developer portfolios around GitHub, live links, tech stacks, and contributions.
Identifies portfolio anti-patterns such as generic templates and style-first showcases.
limitations: It provides guidance, not a complete hosted website.
It cannot verify job offers, client leads, or conversion results.
It needs accurate project details, metrics, visuals, and links from the user.
It does not replace accessibility, performance, SEO, or security testing.

use_cases.title: Plan a Developer Portfolio
use_cases.description: Turn real projects into a clear portfolio structure with GitHub links, live demos, impact statements, and concise case studies.

use_cases.title: Refine a Design Portfolio
use_cases.description: Organize visual work, process artifacts, and project outcomes into case studies that hiring teams can scan quickly.

use_cases.title: Improve a Freelance Showcase
use_cases.description: Focus the homepage, testimonials, selected work, and contact calls to action around client trust and inquiries.

prompt_templates.title: Start a Portfolio Plan
prompt_templates.prompt: Help me plan a portfolio for [role]. I have [number] projects. Suggest sections, navigation, and the first homepage message.

prompt_templates.title: Improve Project Presentation
prompt_templates.prompt: Review these project summaries: [project list]. Recommend stronger project cards, impact statements, visuals, and links for each one.

prompt_templates.title: Build a Case Study Outline
prompt_templates.prompt: Turn this project into a case study: [project details]. Include challenge, role, process, decisions, impact, visuals, and links.

prompt_templates.title: Audit Portfolio Conversion
prompt_templates.prompt: Review my portfolio structure and copy: [paste summary]. Identify weak proof, unclear calls to action, mobile risks, and project gaps.

output_examples.input: A junior frontend developer has three React projects and no site structure.
output: Homepage opens with role, strongest project, and contact action.
Projects show live links, GitHub links, stack, contribution, and impact.
One detailed case study explains the hardest technical decision.

output_examples.input: A designer wants to improve a case study that lists screens but no outcomes.
output: Lead with the user problem and the designer role.
Add process highlights, key tradeoffs, before-and-after visuals, and measurable outcomes.
Move decorative details after evidence of impact.

output_examples.input: A freelancer portfolio gets traffic but few inquiries.
output: Clarify the service offer in the hero section.
Feature the strongest client proof before secondary work.
Make the contact path visible after every major project section.

best_practices: Lead with identity, value, best work, and one contact action.
Choose fewer strong projects and explain the role, decision-making, and impact.
Check mobile layout, page speed, links, and contact flows before sharing.
anti_patterns: Using a generic template without personal voice or project context.
Adding heavy animations before proving the quality of the work.
Listing projects without outcomes, role, process, or next steps.

faq.question: Can this skill help with developer portfolios?
faq.answer: Yes. It emphasizes real projects, GitHub links, live demos, tech stacks, and your specific contribution.

faq.question: Does it create the website for me?
faq.answer: No. It guides structure, messaging, presentation, and review criteria for a portfolio build.

faq.question: Can it help designers and creatives?
faq.answer: Yes. It covers visual case studies, process artifacts, personal branding, and client-focused work presentation.

faq.question: What information should I provide?
faq.answer: Share your target role, project list, outcomes, links, screenshots, testimonials, and contact goals.

faq.question: Does it include conversion advice?
faq.answer: Yes. It focuses on hero clarity, social proof, project proof, and clear contact calls to action.

faq.question: Can it review an existing portfolio?
faq.answer: Yes. Provide the page structure or copy, and ask for issues, priorities, and concrete improvements.
